weaknesses: The paper does not explicitly confirm that evaluation data were kept strictly separate from training/tuning data, raising potential data leakage risks. || Hyperparameter selection (e.g., f=8, ρ=30%) is not explained, and there is no discussion of how these values were determined (e.g., grid search, manual tuning). || Baseline comparisons are not explicitly stated to be under equivalent conditions (e.g., same framework, modality inputs, or hyperparameters). || Statistical significance of performance improvements (e.g., 4.05% accuracy gain over ExMRD) is not tested or reported. || The teacher model (DeepSeek-R1) and student model (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B) are not justified in terms of selection criteria or pre-training data.
